papers.evidence: 将奖品收集TSP近似比改进到1.555761
papers.tldr: 奖赏收集旅行商问题（PC-TSP）允许跳过顶点并支付罚金，目标是最小化巡回长度与未访问顶点罚金之和。此前最佳 LP 相对近似比为 1.599。本文去掉树分解前的 splitting-off 预处理，给出更简单算法，并强化奇偶校正步骤分析，将 LP 相对近似比降至 1.555761，低于 1.556，改进了长期记录。
papers.abstract_en: The prize-collecting traveling salesperson problem is a variant of the metric traveling salesperson problem in which vertices may be left unvisited by paying their associated penalties. The objective is to minimize the length of the tour plus the total penalty of the unvisited vertices. Blauth, Klein, and Nägele gave the previously best-known LP-relative $1.599$-approximation. We show that a simpler version of their algorithm, obtained by omitting the splitting-off preprocessing before the tree decomposition, has an LP-relative approximation ratio of $1.555761$. The improvement comes from a stronger analysis of the parity-correction step.
